Name: Dentistry
Author: KronosTitanAnthem
Description:
[b]Note: This mod requires Content Patcher 2.0.0 or later with Stardew Valley 1.6.[/b]

For whatever reason, I had a weird idea a while ago to make a mod adding dentistry to Stardew Valley, for absolutely no reason other than to be funny/weird, I guess? I decided to actually make it, so here it is!

[size=5]Content[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Pierre will now sell "Dentist's Mint Seeds". You can plant them to get Dentist's Mint. It grows in spring, summer, and fall.[/size]
[*][size=3]Giving Harvey Dentist's Mint or walking into the Hospital for the first time will trigger a cutscene. You will receive one Dentistry Table along with the crafting recipe to make more.[/size]
[*][size=3]Putting either Dentist's Mint or a fruit into the Dentistry Table will give you [ingredient] Toothpaste instantly. The sell value is: [/size]
[/list] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿﻿[price of ingredient] * 2 + 75
[list]
[*][size=3]Be careful though, different ingredient Toothpastes will stack for some reason, so don't have a different flavor in your inventory when you make new toothpaste.[/size]
[*][size=3]Putting wood, stone, or metal bars into the Dentistry Table will give you Dentures of their respective kinds (these do not stack cross-material). This gives you a decent sell price increase.[/size]
[*][size=3]Toothpaste is a universally liked gift, while Harvey loves it.[/size]
[*][size=3]Wood and Stone Dentures are universally hated gifts, while the rest of the dentures are universally disliked. However, George and Harvey both like dentures, and Vincent and Jas love Iridium Dentures (because they think it's fun to have purple teeth). The kids actually don't accept non-iridium dentures, instead they laugh it off with no friendship effect, and you keep the denture.[/size]
[*][size=3]There's a few special dialogues when you give Harvey toothpaste, dentures, or Dentist's Mint (the mint will replay the hospital event), or George, Vincent, or Jas dentures.[/size]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: For Stardew Valley 1.6, SMAPI 4.0.0, and Content Patcher 2.0.0
